lemmas.primary_translation: unroll / shape by rolling / implement in rapid succession / introduce across a larger area

examples.en: they rolled out the artificial turf

definitions.text: forme noe til en kule eller sylinder med roterende bevegelser med hendene
definitions.translation: shape something into a ball or cylinder using rotating movements of the hands

definitions.text: sette i verk noe på løpende bånd
definitions.translation: implement something one after another, on a continuous basis

examples.no: de ruller ut bredbånd i hele distriktet
examples.en: they are rolling out broadband throughout the district
